flow_summary: The interview shows multiple failures to recover a deflected answer (patient's name clarification ignored at start) and to accept 'I don't know' once for biological treatments, instead looping four follow-up questions. Redundant re-asks occur for DOB and postal code after clear answers, and the medication section drifts into repetitive past/current distinctions that confuse the patient. Safety disclosure receives a proportionate query but no other major tangents or bundled questions appear.

issues.evidence: Turn 1: Patient asks 'Do you want my legal name, or just what I go by?' and interviewer immediately switches to gender without addressing it.
Past psychiatric turns 11-15: After 'I don’t know of any of those, no' and repeated 'I don’t know', interviewer asks when, where, sessions, and duration anyway.
General info turns 3-4 and 6-7: DOB and postal code are re-asked in specific format after patient already gave exact values.
